== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Incarnation|The Incarnation]] of [[Elysia]] is a title held by [[Alin]], the son of [[Torin]]. As an individual born as a [[Traveler]] from one of the most potent Territories, [[Alin]] is considered nearly invincible. The role is characterized by a lack of self-control and an absence of both conscience and empathy, representing a form of morality that lacks human sympathy. Historically, the [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]] governed all other Territories and were responsible for managing any [[Incarnation]] that entered their world. While it was believed that a single [[Territory]] could only host one [[Incarnation]] at any given time, [[Alin]] claims the identity of [[Elysia]] for himself. The first person to hold this title was a figure who nearly caused the [[destruction]] of [[Damasca]] and served during the era of [[Queen]] [[Cynara]] the First.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Alin]] serves as [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] of [[Elysia]], a figure observed by Feiora Torannus as she limped away. Due to the nature of her [[Territory]], [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] is characterized by an honesty that borders on being too blunt. Although the King has developed plans regarding her existence, she possesses a power capable of matching even the blue [[giant]].}}
